entities.summary: Bose Ogunboye known professionally as Lepacious Bose is a Nigerian comedienne and Nollywood actress. In 2014, she won the 2014 Golden Icons Academy Movie Awards for Best Comedic Act category award in the movie “Being Mrs Elliot” beating other 6 contestants.
